name: Treats for Great-father Winter
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Hey, can you do Great-father Winter a favor, um, little  boy ?

Not to needlessly talk about myself in the third person, but Great-father Winter has been at this all day and he could use a treat himself.  Some gingerbread cookies and ice cold milk to wash them down with would really hit the spot.  Think you could be a friend to the Great-father and fetch some for me?
narrative.objectives: Bring 5 Gingerbread Cookies and an Ice Cold Milk to Great-father Winter in Orgrimmar.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You're quite the helper to ol' Great-father Winter there, adventurer.  Have a great Feast of Winter Veil.

Here's a little something... you know, for the effort.
narrative.requestItemsText: All this talk of treats has given me a hankering for some myself.  Mmmm... gingerbread cookies and milk...
